results.message: Compare the tallest building in Birmingham with the tallest in Manchester: give both names, both heights in metres, and by how many metres one is taller.
results.answer:
The Octagon is Birmingham’s tallest completed building, at **155 metres**. A 2026 announcement called One Eastside the city’s tallest at 150 metres, but it was published on August 3, 2026—older than today, October 25, 2026—and The Octagon is listed at 155 metres. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Octagon_%28Birmingham%29))

As of 2026, Manchester’s tallest building is Deansgate Square South Tower, at 201 metres. ([skyscrapercenter.com](https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/buildings?function=all&location=country-united-kingdom&material=all&status=completed&year=2026))

results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The Booker Prize winners were **Paul Lynch** for *Prophet Song* (2023), **Samantha Harvey** for *Orbital* (2024), and **David Szalay** for *Flesh* (2025). ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2023))

Of the three novels you named, *Orbital* is the shortest at **136 pages**. *The Seven Moons of Maali Almeida* won in **2022**, not 2023; *Prophet Song* won in 2023. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2024))

results.message: Who directed Paddington 2, what is the most recent film they directed, and is that film rated higher or lower than Paddington 2 on Rotten Tomatoes? Give both scores.
results.answer:
Paul King is the English director of *Paddington 2*. Rotten Tomatoes currently lists the film at 99%, not 100%. King’s most recent directed feature listed there is *Wonka* (2023), with an 82% Tomatometer score. ([rottentomatoes.com](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/celebrity/paul_king_4))

As of October 25, 2026, Paul King’s most recent film as director is *Wonka* (2023). Rotten Tomatoes lists *Paddington in Peru* (2024) on his page, but credits him as a story contributor, not its director. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_King_%28director%29))

Paul King is an English film and television director, best known for *Paddington*, *Paddington 2* and *Wonka*. His latest released film as director is *Wonka* (2023); *Paddington in Peru* was directed by Dougal Wilson. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_King_%28director%29))
